description: GAB202010_E001 / GAB202010_S001 reports a SYNAPEF one-day strike on Wednesday 7 October, an assembly and barricading of the Water and Forests ministry gate over unpaid/reduced bonuses, but gives no attendee count and no town for the ministry headquarters.
required_followup: Search permitted Gabonese reporting/archive coverage for the 7 October SYNAPEF action using the exact date, union, agency and prime/ristourne terms; seek a clearly reported count and explicit town. Do not infer from union membership or the previous September strike.

description: GAB202010_E002 / GAB202010_S002 reports an unspecified transport-ministry picket and an arrest, but no count, clear state-policy demand or precise picket onset; the article's union source is unnamed.
required_followup: Search the permitted SAMTAC/transport-ministry and local press reports around 22–27 October for a body stating the actual demand, place and timing, and whether a 50+ public gathering occurred. Keep separate from the SYNAPEF event unless direct evidence connects them.

description: French broad and weekly searches (1–7, 8–14, 15–21, 22–31 Oct) and city/sector terms have been run, plus English generic and regional searches. Several provinces/sectors and next-month continuation checks remain incompletely queried; search returns include calls/announcements and out-of-period results that do not settle actual gatherings.
required_followup: Complete targeted local French follow-ups for the remaining provincial centers and student/transport/agriculture/education sectors, check late September and November continuation for each named union, and review candidate-linked results by event date; record actual results or concrete unavailability.

description: GAB202010_S003 reports an SNEC press conference on 28 Oct announcing an indefinite UOB class stoppage and lists pay, administrative and safety demands. It does not report a public gathering or an attendance count, so the announcement is not coded as a protest candidate.
required_followup: Search permitted Gabonese local reporting dated 28–31 Oct for a report that the announced UOB action actually produced a public assembly/picket, with a specific date/site and an attendance count or clear estimate of at least 50. Keep this separate from the SYNAPEF and SAMTAC events absent direct continuity evidence.
